of Rights on Divorce) Act of 1986?

Personal Law.

solution.quick: The Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Divorce) Act of 1986 was passed by the Rajiv Gandhi Congress government to nullify the Supreme Court's 1985 Shah Bano judgment.

Most women's organizations opposed the Act.
